metadata.title: Phase 3 Model Experiment Results Manifest
metadata.metric_disclaimer: All metrics are evaluated against binary sampled background labels (s in {0, 1}). Background points are unlabeled landscape locations, NOT confirmed negatives. Scores represent a Relative Landslide Susceptibility Index (RLSI), NOT calibrated real-world probabilities.

spatial_cluster_bootstrap.limitations: Cluster bootstrap resamples spatial coordinate blocks to respect spatial dependence. Confidence intervals are illustrative asymptotic approximations due to finite cluster counts per district.
